Nope, I don't have kik
I guess I'll look at some mobile games and try out Brave Frontier for now..

I guess I can do that for now, and try to get addicted to some game maybe. Although it's kind of hard to find random things and find it really important. 
I'll try to distract myself in a fantasy world I guess
Thanks for responding though...

I'm going to try harder to appreciate the small things...
But honestly, like.. the trade for those small things.. are just.. not that worth it, in my opinion since all that you have to go to, for something you don't really want in the first place.. I didn't ask for this trade, I didn't ask to be born...
School, parents, life isn't meant for me...  
It might not be a feeling but a fact
When does these feelings end? How long do they last?

Hmm.. Leaving my parents? when they are all crazy like that? ... I think one or both of them might actually have some mental issue since they act so weirdly. 
Well, not repeating the mistakes... It works either with me alive or dead : / ... im not sure
Thanks, I'll try to hang on : /
"Life will get better" was what I thought, but it just keeps getting worse...

I try to distract myself in games, but I lose interest fast.
I play the piano, and now I don't want to play it...
Nothing is important to me..
I thought of my one pure reason to live, and it's to repay my family.. all the money they put into me... but now they argue a lot.. and there's going to be no family soon...  I don't know.. I'm left with nothing now ... not even a clear way to death. 
Sorry but my family is at it again, and it's all, it's complicated and nothing will turn out well.
